featured_reviews.name: Niyati Basrur
featured_reviews.review_text:
I initially took my car to Mumbai Motor Works for what I thought was a simple AC issue. It was almost closing time, but Mr. Harneet Singh Anand didn't turn me away. Instead, he took the time to get the car checked and personally ensured that it received attention.

What happened next is exactly why honest automotive professionals are worth their weight in gold.

While looking into the AC problem, Mr. Harneet identified two serious issues with my car—a suspension problem and a steering rack issue. As someone who regularly travels with family, it was concerning to learn that these faults could potentially have compromised our safety on the road. I am genuinely grateful that these problems were detected before they turned into something far more serious.

What impressed me most throughout the process was Mr. Harneet's integrity. He never once tried to create panic or exaggerate the repairs needed. Instead, he clearly explained the issues and, wherever it was safe and practical to do so, recommended repairing components rather than replacing them. This saved us a significant amount of unnecessary expense without compromising on safety or quality.

What also stood out was his attention to detail. Beyond resolving the major issues, he took care of several smaller concerns that had been bothering us for a while, including fixing the automatic car key and repairing a loose side-view mirror. It was evident that he genuinely wanted to return the car in the best possible condition rather than simply complete the minimum work required.

In an industry where trust can sometimes be hard to come by, Mr. Harneet has restored my faith. He is knowledgeable, transparent, fair, and genuinely cares about both the vehicle and the people driving it.

If you're looking for an automotive professional you can trust—someone who values safety, honesty, and quality workmanship—I would highly recommend Mumbai Motor Works. They have certainly earned a customer for life.

featured_reviews.name: Akshata Balgi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Mumbai Motor Works purely based on the positive reviews I had read online, without any prior knowledge of the place. I went there to get a rear-view camera installed in my Maruti Espresso.
I was extremely impressed with the owners, Mr. Titu Anand ji and his son Mr. Honey Singh. Both were incredibly patient, courteous, and professional. They took the time to explain the product, its features, and the best options for my car in great detail, without any pressure to upsell.
What stood out the most was their genuine approach—they clearly value building long-term relationships with customers rather than just making a quick sale. The installation was done perfectly, and the overall experience left me truly satisfied and happy.
Highly recommended! Thank you, Mumbai Motor Works, for the excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Singhania
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve known Mumbai Motorworks near the Gurudwara in Andheri East since I grew up around the block, but I recently had the chance to experience their service firsthand during an emergency. They were incredibly kind and took the time to patiently explain all the issues my car was facing, and still managed to get it back to me within the hour.

After being away for a while, I returned to get the remaining concerns addressed, including a hole in the silencer and a few persistent issues that were affecting my overall driving experience. Not only did they fix everything wholeheartedly, but they once again took the time to educate me about my car and how to maintain it better.

It’s rare to find someone who is this knowledgeable, transparent, patient, and genuinely helpful. If you truly care about your car, whether it’s new or old. I would highly recommend Mumbai Motorworks.

featured_reviews.name: maninder singh panesar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely fantastic experience with Banai Auto! I gave my XUV 500 for servicing, and I’m genuinely impressed with the quality of work delivered. The team handled everything with great professionalism and care. From clear communication to timely updates, the entire process was smooth and hassle-free.

What stood out the most was their attention to detail — the car feels as good as new, both in performance and overall condition. They clearly know their work and take pride in doing it right. It’s not easy to find such reliable and honest service these days.

Thank you Balram sir for all the efforts taken by you and ur team.

Highly satisfied and would definitely recommend Banai Auto to anyone looking for trustworthy and top-quality car servicing. Keep up the great work!
